More than a structure.
A connected way
of building.

Sri Lankan expertise.

DKS Builders provides turnkey construction across Sri Lanka, bringing civil, interior, electrical and mechanical expertise together. Based in Elpitiya, we work across residential, commercial, industrial and public-sector construction.

Thought through.
Built together.

    BRIEF
